nodes.label: Ready to report
nodes.description: Assign a gate that must hold before this is reported as complete.

nodes.label: Implement
nodes.description: Work the plan. Keep each step small enough to verify.

nodes.label: Plan the change
nodes.description: Write the steps, in order, with the smallest first change that can be verified.

config.outputSpec: the plan output, listing every resource that would change or be destroyed

nodes.label: Review the change
nodes.description: Read the diff as a reviewer: does it meet the acceptance criteria, does it match the conventions, does it leave anything half-done?

nodes.label: Read the surrounding code
nodes.description: Find the existing patterns this change must match: naming, layering, error handling, tests.

config.outputSpec: the files that will change and the conventions to follow

nodes.label: Understand the request
nodes.description: Restate the request, list what is in scope and what is not, and name the acceptance criteria.

config.outputSpec: a restatement, the scope boundary and the acceptance criteria

nodes.label: Verify
nodes.description: Run the project checks and read the output.
